source.title: Shifting Scale Talisman
source.description:
I'll need a... nominal amount of materials for the talisman.

<N'ora smiles sheepishly at you>
source.objective: Bring N'ora Anyheart the following materials alongside the Handful of Shifting Scales to complete the talisman: A satchel of Strange Dust, five Greater Magic Essence, 2 Small Glimmering Shards and five gold pieces.
source.progress: I'll concede that I'm not much of an enchanter, but I think I have a fairly solid grasp on the process. In principle, anyway.
source.completion: I wish you the best on your adventures and hope you find your way back to me should you encounter any other wonderous discoveries such as this!
